# datadog_integration_nebius_cloud_account (Resource)

Provides a Datadog Nebius Cloud integration account resource.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authentication` (Attributes) Authentication configured on the Nebius Cloud integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication))
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Nebius Cloud integration account.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings configured on the Nebius Cloud integration account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings))

### Optional

- `dataflows` (Attributes) Data Datadog collects from Nebius Cloud, keyed by dataflow id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--authentication"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication`

Optional:

- `nebius_cloud_integration_account_service_account_auth` (Attributes) The service-account key pair authentication method configured on the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--authentication--nebius_cloud_integration_account_service_account_auth))

<a id="nestedatt--authentication--nebius_cloud_integration_account_service_account_auth"></a>
### Nested Schema for `authentication.nebius_cloud_integration_account_service_account_auth`

Required:

- `service_account_id` (String) ID of the Nebius service account the account authenticates as.

Optional:

- `auth_type` (String) The authentication method type. Valid values are `nebius_service_account`. Defaults to `"nebius_service_account"`.
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) The private key of the authorized key pair, in PEM format. Required when log, resource, or service-quota collection is enabled; a request that enables one of them without it is rejected with a `422` response. Conflicts with `private_key_wo`. Prefer `private_key_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `private_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) The private key of the authorized key pair, in PEM format. Required when log, resource, or service-quota collection is enabled; a request that enables one of them without it is rejected with a `422` response. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `private_key_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for private_key_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.
- `public_key_id` (String) ID of the public key half of the authorized key pair. Omitted when unset.
- `static_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Nebius static API key with the OBSERVABILITY scope, used to query logs. Required when log, resource, or service-quota collection is enabled; a request that enables one of them without it is rejected with a `422` response. Conflicts with `static_api_key_wo`. Prefer `static_api_key_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `static_api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Nebius static API key with the OBSERVABILITY scope, used to query logs. Required when log, resource, or service-quota collection is enabled; a request that enables one of them without it is rejected with a `422` response. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `static_api_key_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for static_api_key_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.



<a id="nestedatt--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings`

Required:

- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Nebius tenant being monitored.

Optional:

- `account_tags` (List of String) Tags applied to all data collected from this Nebius Cloud account.
- `metrics_config` (Attributes) Metric collection settings configured on the Nebius Cloud integration account. Absent or empty when no filters are configured. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--settings--metrics_config))

<a id="nestedatt--settings--metrics_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `settings.metrics_config`

Optional:

- `cluster_filters` (List of String) Tag-filter rules limiting metric collection to matching Kubernetes clusters.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows`

Optional:

- `nebius_cloud_cost_collection` (Attributes) Cloud cost data read from a Nebius Object Storage bucket export and used by [Cloud Cost Management](https://docs.datadoghq.com/cloud_cost_management/). Requires a bucket holding your cost export and a Nebius access key pair that can read it; without both this dataflow collects no data. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_cost_collection))
- `nebius_cloud_logs` (Attributes) Logs from your Nebius tenant: Kubernetes control plane and audit logs, tenant-level audit events, compute serial console logs, cloud apps and AI inference logs, PostgreSQL logs, and MLflow logs, collected from the services named in `settings.enabled_services`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_logs))
- `nebius_cloud_resources` (Attributes) Metadata about resources in your Nebius tenant, such as compute instances and Kubernetes clusters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_resources))
- `nebius_cloud_service_quota_collection` (Attributes) Usage metrics tracked against your Nebius service quotas, such as `nebius_cloud.servicequota.percentage_used` and `nebius_cloud.servicequota.limit`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_service_quota_collection))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_cost_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.nebius_cloud_cost_collection`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data. Absent when the dataflow has never been configured.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the Cloud Cost Management dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_cost_collection--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_cost_collection--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.nebius_cloud_cost_collection.settings`

Optional:

- `access_key_id` (String) ID of the Nebius Object Storage access key used to read the cost export bucket.
- `access_key_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret access key for the access key ID. Required when this dataflow is enabled. Omit it on update to keep the stored one; an empty string is rejected with a `422` response. Conflicts with `access_key_secret_wo`. Prefer `access_key_secret_wo`, which Terraform 1.11+ keeps out of state; this attribute is stored in Terraform state.
- `access_key_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Secret access key for the access key ID. Required when this dataflow is enabled. Omit it on update to keep the stored one; an empty string is rejected with a `422` response. This write-only value is not stored in Terraform state. Requires Terraform 1.11+.
- `access_key_secret_wo_version` (String) Version trigger for access_key_secret_wo rotation. String length must be at least 1.
- `bucket_name` (String) Name of the Nebius Object Storage bucket holding the cost export.
- `bucket_prefix_path` (String) Prefix path within the bucket that locates the cost export.
- `bucket_region` (String) Region of the Nebius Object Storage bucket, such as `eu-north1`.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_logs"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.nebius_cloud_logs`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects logs. Absent when no service is enabled.
- `settings` (Attributes) Settings of the logs dataflow. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_logs--settings))

<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_logs--settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.nebius_cloud_logs.settings`

Optional:

- `enabled_services` (List of String) Nebius log integrations collected, such as `nebius-cloud-compute` and `default`. Absent when no service is enabled.



<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_resources"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.nebius_cloud_resources`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data. Absent when the dataflow has never been configured, in which case collection runs when `authentication.public_key_id` is set.


<a id="nestedatt--dataflows--nebius_cloud_service_quota_collection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dataflows.nebius_cloud_service_quota_collection`

Optional:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether Datadog collects this data. Absent when the dataflow has never been configured.
